the CEA region is a key region for understanding the climate variability in the Atlantic sector.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CEA rainfall is influenced at interannual and multi-year timescales by large-scale atmospheric dynamics over the North Atlantic sector.
the North Atlantic is not just a passive player in the climate of the tropics but it can have a significant impact on climate variability in the African tropics.
